purpose: Provisional readiness improvement catalog for local pilot; content must be independently reviewed before public launch

actions.title: Identify someone to verify missing answers
actions.validation: Obtain answers for the three highest-uncertainty indicators
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Check how an important record is created and corrected
actions.validation: Walk through one recent record and identify its source and corrections
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Clarify which business decision needs improvement
actions.validation: Write a one-sentence goal and an observable result
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Write the steps of one repeated business task
actions.validation: Observe one task from start to finish and note handoffs
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Identify one authoritative source for essential records
actions.validation: List where the same information appears and designate its authoritative source
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Clean a small representative set of key records
actions.validation: Check 20 records for missing, outdated, or duplicate fields
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Measure a workflow before changing it
actions.validation: Record time, errors or volume for five recent instances
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Set simple AI and data-handling rules
actions.validation: Define prohibited data sharing and a clear escalation contact
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Review access to customer and staff information
actions.validation: Review who can see and export critical records
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Stop unsafe sharing and review affected workflows
actions.validation: Stop unmanaged sharing; document and escalate suspected exposure
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Agree when a human must approve AI outputs
actions.validation: Define decisions that cannot be automated without review
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Run a practical AI-literacy walkthrough
actions.validation: Demonstrate one safe use and one failure case; verify understanding
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Nominate a person to support adoption
actions.validation: Assign a named person and an initial review date
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Introduce a simple output-checking checklist
actions.validation: Require a human check for accuracy and confidentiality
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Map where information is copied between systems
actions.validation: Record one end-to-end handoff and the systems involved
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Standardize key spreadsheet or system fields
actions.validation: Agree field names and required values for a recurring record
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Evaluate a basic integration option
actions.validation: Compare an existing feature with current manual cost, without purchasing yet
actions.cash_note: Potential external cost; only proceed when a dated quote is available.

actions.title: Define a low-risk AI pilot hypothesis
actions.validation: Specify one task, success measure, and stop condition
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Create a small human-reviewed evaluation set
actions.validation: Collect non-sensitive examples and expected human judgments
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Review the pilot with an accountable owner
actions.validation: Review quality, use, incident notes and actual effort
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Obtain domain-specific expert review before piloting
actions.validation: Document proposed decision, affected people, and professional review needed
actions.cash_note: Specialist quote needed before a cash recommendation.

actions.title: Define high-impact decision authority and escalation
actions.validation: Name approver and person responsible for challenging automated recommendations
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Check current access to the information needed
actions.validation: Identify which records are available and whom to ask for missing information
actions.cash_note: External cash not required by the template action; staff time is required.

actions.title: Confirm whether the organization needs a specialist privacy review
actions.validation: List relevant data types and planned use; request jurisdiction-specific advice
actions.cash_note: Specialist quote needed before a cash recommendation.

cost_classes.C0: No required external cash; staff time still costs effort
cost_classes.C1: May incur low external spend; no numeric price until verified
cost_classes.C2: Moderate external spend; no numeric price until verified

selection_rule: Select path by numeric gates and precedence; select three actions whose prerequisites are met or explicitly called out; all paths may be supported by other actions; never auto-assert cash affordability without a current quote.
